verdict.rationale: Anytype documents its own import feature: content can be imported into spaces, and there is an Obsidian/Markdown import (Channel Settings → Import → Obsidian) that creates a separate object for each Markdown file. That covers the plain-Markdown path only, with no stated guarantees about what survives. Missing for 10: any evidence of Notion, Evernote, or Roam importers; documented preservation of inter-note links, attachments, and hierarchy/structure; independent or hands-on corroboration of import fidelity.
